name: SereniBase Self-Hosted Backend
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted backend platform with PostgreSQL, automatic REST APIs, JWT authentication, storage, SMTP notifications and ClamAV scanning; no software usage quota or expiration stated.
watch_out: Beta software; requires your own Docker host, PostgreSQL, storage and operational maintenance. External SMTP, S3 or cloud infrastructure may incur separate charges; the public demo is not a free hosted production plan.
